coverage_questions: The paper documents OpticalDNA across all six pretraining task families T1-T6. Exact decoder tokenization, image-token injection, shifted teacher-forcing construction, attention masks, and loss-mask implementation remain unspecified.

The Stage 2 fusion trainability is internally inconsistent: the prose states that F θ is fixed, while Table S18 reports full updating. The reconstruction preserves both statements as unresolved evidence.

The paper documents categorical task sampling and prompt-length annealing, but does not specify the implementation of prompt-template lookup or the exact serialized prompt strings used for each sampled instance.
The paper documents tail truncation for T2/T3/T5 and no tail truncation for T4/T6. Exact truncation sampling, page-removal implementation, and target regeneration code remain unspecified.
The paper documents line-span sampling, annotation-based box extraction, and subsequence match enumeration, but the exact span-to-box and match-to-box implementations are opaque.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Rasterize genomic sequence into annotated RGB DNA-document pages

operation_proposals.source_operation: SAM-Conv-CLIP-L visual front-end with fixed convolutional downsampling

operation_proposals.source_operation: Mean reduction over the page dimension after multi-page self-attention
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no reduction or pooling operation whose declared semantics represent averaging across the page axis.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Structured multimodal conversation assembly and teacher-forced decoder receipt
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The documented input combines role fields, textual content, an image placeholder, an ordered image list, a NUM IMAGES meta line, fused visual tokens, and shifted assistant-response tokens; no existing operation represents this complete multimodal message boundary.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Enumerate all occurrences of a sampled nucleotide query across rendered lines and convert matches to spatial boxes
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog represents sampling, selection, partitioning, and alignment separately, but has no primitive for symbolic subsequence matching followed by spatial match enumeration.
